changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE ingestion_checkpoints ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, user_id UUID NOT NULL, year INT NOT NULL, month INT NOT NULL, transaction_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, total_amount DECIMAL(19,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, category_summary JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', last_processed_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), embedded BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT uq_checkpoint_user_month UNIQUE(user_id, year, month) );
